text:
Instant AI creation from anywhere on the web - reference styles or swap faces with one click.Higgsfield Instant brings AI-powered image generation directly to your browser. See an inspiring style? Recreate it with your Soul Character. Spot a photo you want your face in? Swap it instantly. No downloading, no platform switching, no prompts – just right-click and create.

Two tools, zero friction:
 • Soul Recreation: Transform any image into your character's style
 • Face Swap: Put any face into any photo you find online

Perfect for creators who need instant results while browsing social media, gathering inspiration, or responding to trends. Download the extension and turn every image on the web into your creative playground.
